1. translated The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.
2. translated For God speaks in one way and in another, yet no one notices.
3. translated However, the hair of his head began to grow back after it had been shaved.
4. translated The LORD of Hosts has sworn by Himself: “Surely I will fill you up with men as with locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you.”

4. translated I struck you—all the work of your hands—with blight, mildew, and hail, but you did not turn to Me, declares the LORD.

1. translated A Greeting from the Elder
2. translated The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
3. translated Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
4. translated For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.

1. translated I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
2. translated Gaius Commended for Hospitality
3. translated Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.
4. translated They have testified to the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.

1. translated For they went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.
2. translated Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
3. translated Diotrephes and Demetrius
4. translated I have written to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.

1. translated So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.
2. translated Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
3. translated Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
4. translated Conclusion

1. translated I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
2. translated Instead, I hope to see you soon and speak with you face to face. Peace to you. The friends here send you greetings. Greet each of our friends there by name.
